name: Apollo 11
traveler: Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins
summary: Eight days, 1.5 million kilometres, and the first people to walk on another world. Collins circles the Moon alone while Armstrong and Aldrin spend about two and a half hours outside on the surface.

stops.note: A Saturn V lifts off at 13:32 UTC.
One and a half orbits, then the third stage fires toward the Moon over the Pacific.
Apollo 11 slips into orbit behind the Moon, out of radio contact.
At 02:56 UTC Armstrong steps onto the surface; Aldrin follows.
Eagle lifts off and rejoins Collins in Columbia.
The USS Hornet recovers the crew.

informs.note: The first people on another world
